abstention_condition: no certified مادة present → stay candidate_root; never certify from pattern shape
defeaters: an explicit certified مادة from a reviewed-lexicography source certifies the root
MCP/QAC agreement on the root (after orthography normalization) certifies

projector.condition: root asserted with provenance root_from=='surface_pattern' and no certified_madda
projector.projection: downgrade to candidate_root_uncertified; block public root certification

relationships.note: Adds a pattern-shape certification bar upstream of the ownership evidence set.

scope: A surface pattern (وزن) NEVER certifies a root. است/مست may be Form VIII of a weak/hamza root (استوى→سوي, مستمعون→سمع); a ت-initial shape may be ibdāl (تتخذوا→أخذ). Roots are two-tier: candidate_root from any inference, certified_root ONLY from an explicit مادة in a reviewed-lexicography source.

abstention_condition: root weakness unconfirmed by a certified source → route to review, do not silently pass
defeaters: the weak radicals are visible contiguously in the surface (strong verb)
the token is a ت-prefix nominal already covered by the nominal detector

projector.condition: is_whole_token_verb and certified root_is_weak and weak radicals absent from surface
guards: certified مادة needed to confirm root weakness
projector.projection: flag as a C2 completeness defect (candidate for repair)

relationships.note: Extends the completeness gate to weak whole-token verbs.

scope: A whole-token verb whose certified root is weak (lafīf/nāqiṣ/ajwaf) and whose weak radicals are absent from the contiguous surface (يتوفى exposes neither و nor ي) must be flagged as an incompleteness defect; the ت-prefix nominal allow-lists miss it.

abstention_condition: sources disagree post-normalization → block certification, route 2-vote / owner-gate
defeaters: the two roots are identical after w/y→و/ي normalization (false alarm) → certify agreed
only one certified source is present → single-source candidate, not a conflict

projector.condition: two certified source roots present and normalized(root_a) != normalized(root_b)
projector.projection: block certification; emit both candidate roots; route engine-diverse 2-vote

relationships.note: Adds a cross-source conflict veto to root certification.

scope: When two certified sources give roots that DIFFER after orthography normalization (MCP ألك vs QAC ملك for ملائكة), neither certifies alone: record both candidates, route the engine-diverse 2-vote, and NEVER majority-vote a root. Normalize MCP ي-final vs QAC w/y before comparing so romanization never false-alarms.

abstention_condition: jāmid/etymology-contested → 2-vote; do not root-assert from a single source
defeaters: token is مشتق with a certified root → wave-eligible after review (C2a)
certified source itself marks the token جامد or foreign → root-silent (C2b)

projector.condition: token flagged is_jamid (certified) → route; else is_derived with certified root → wave
guards: jāmid flag from a certified source
projector.projection: route jāmid to 2-vote + suppress root-assertion; route مشتق to review-then-wave

relationships.note: Distinguishes derived (root-exposing) from jāmid (root-silent) C2 tokens.

scope: Split C2 into C2a (مشتق, root certified, derived) → wave-eligible after review, and C2b (جامد / etymology-contested: ملكوت فَعَلُوت, مثاني, مسكين-debate) → auto-route 2-vote and the gloss may ship ROOT-SILENT. The detector must not message a jāmid token as 'derived whole-token'.

defeaters: stated word-index resolves byte-exact to the row surface within the āyah → emit

projector.condition: stated_word_index > āyah word count (impossible) OR stated != resolved (mismatch)
guards: resolve against the live wbw index + āyah word count
projector.projection: fail closed; block the wave write; reroute mismatches to the addressing lane

relationships.note: Extends deploy-mechanics: a loc must resolve to its surface before any write.

scope: Before emitting or deploying a row, resolve canonical_location→surface against the corpus/wbw tokenization and FAIL CLOSED on mismatch or impossibility. FIVE independent finds across C1/C2/C5 — 25:33:2→8, 61:4:3→11 (C2); 17:92:2→9 (C5); 2:91:3→word23 (measured-effect); and the IMPOSSIBLE 4:91:103 (the āyah has 32 words) (C1) — prove any wave keyed on a stated loc could write a gloss onto the wrong word or a non-existent one. Mis-addressed rows reroute to the addressing lane; impossible addresses fail closed.

abstention_condition: hamza unresolved after diacritic + MCP check → abstain; never emit the 1s-or-FormIV disjunction
defeaters: diacritics/MCP commit one reading → emit that reading, not the disjunction
hamza is the interrogative particle (أَجَعَلَ) → segment it as harf istifhām, not morphology

projector.condition: output would emit the '1s imperfect or Form IV' disjunction on an أ-initial verb
projector.projection: BLOCK the disjunction string; require a committed reading or abstention

relationships.note: Bars the lazy hamza disjunction from the form-derivation output.

scope: An أ-initial verb token must be resolved among {1s imperfect, Form IV perfect, Form IV imperative, interrogative particle + verb} BEFORE any person/aspect tag is emitted. The lazy disjunction '1st person singular or Form IV' is a BLOCKED output — commit via diacritics/MCP or abstain. This disjunction caused 4/10 C4 hard errors.

defeaters: the form is genuinely 3rd-person and NOT imperative (perfect/imperfect) → invariant n/a

projector.condition: aspect == imperative and person does not start with '2'
guards: aspect must first be committed (see hamza/vocalism rules)
projector.projection: hard violation; block deploy; SUBJ gloss must be 2nd person, never 'they'

relationships.note: The imperative-person invariant is a hard check on the committed occurrence.

scope: HARD invariant (validator-grade): if aspect == imperative the subject person is 2nd (2ms/2fs/2mp/2fp) and a 3rd-person tag or SUBJ gloss 'they' is a violation. 'Imperative + person-tag that is 3rd' caught 9/10 C4 hard errors with zero MCP; 5/5 sampled tagged imperatives were wrong.

abstention_condition: qirāʾāt-split or undiacritized on voice → abstain with a named qiraat_note; else commit
defeaters: address is qirāʾāt-split on voice, or undiacritized → named-ambiguity abstention is legal

projector.condition: diacritized surface has u-i (perfect) or u-a (imperfect) vocalism
projector.projection: commit voice=passive (or active for a-a/a-u); replace the 'as context requires' hedge

relationships.note: Voice is one of the per-occurrence facts that must be committed, not hedged.

scope: ُ-ِ perfect / ُ-َ imperfect vocalism ⇒ commit voice=passive; a-a perfect / a-u imperfect ⇒ active. 'active/passive as context requires' is legal ONLY for an undiacritized or qirāʾāt-split address — none exist in the fully-vocalized Uthmani corpus in-sample.

defeaters: morphline asserts person AND mood → the completeness claim is truthful and may render

projector.condition: learner text claims person/number/mood completeness while morphline abstains on person or mood
guards: no morphology authoring required for the honesty fix
projector.projection: swap to the honest-generic learner variant (deterministic, zero morphology work)

relationships.note: The completeness claim must reconcile with the asserted morphline facts.
relationships.target_id: sarf §13d VN-00 visual completeness ANDON, SKILL.md:236

scope: The learner_explanation 'the hover exposes … the person/number/mood facts' may render ONLY when the morphline actually asserts person AND mood; otherwise the generator must emit the honest-generic variant. 523/523 C4 rows carried this claim while the morphline abstained on exactly those facts.

defeaters: all present person fields agree → consistent

projector.condition: distinct person values across {pfx_seg, morphline, subj_seg, learner_text} > 1
projector.projection: hard violation; block deploy until the fields are reconciled

relationships.note: Person carried by segments must equal the morphline's person.

scope: Internal consistency (validator-grade): the PFX-segment person, the morphline person, the SUBJ-segment person and the learner-text person must all agree. 17:12:16 self-contradicts (PFX seg '2nd person' while the morphline tags 3mp) and no gate caught it.

defeaters: the ت is an inflectional muḍāriʿ prefix (يَـ/تَـ/نَـ/أَـ seat) not a Form V/VI wazn augment

projector.condition: wazn ∈ {تفعّل, تفاعل} and the token has a leading ت
guards: distinguish inflectional muḍāriʿ ت (own segment) from the wazn ت
projector.projection: keep the ت in the stem as a wazn augment; do NOT emit it as a proclitic segment

relationships.note: Boundary partner: the inflectional ت IS a segment; the Form V/VI wazn ت is NOT.

scope: The ت of Form V (تفعّل) and Form VI (تفاعل) is a زائد wazn augment (Shadhā al-ʿArf, primary source) — it is stem-internal and is NEVER peeled as a proclitic. An inflectional muḍāriʿ ت prefix (a different ت) IS its own segment; the two must not be conflated.

abstention_condition: root unresolved → do not assert a clitic peel of a possibly-radical letter
defeaters: the letter is not among the root radicals → it is a genuine clitic and keeps its segment

projector.condition: candidate_clitic_letter ∈ root_radicals (final or initial)
guards: compare against the morphline root or certified مادة
projector.projection: PREVENT the clitic projection; the letter stays part of the stem/root

relationships.note: A radical-homograph veto on the clitic-peel side of ownership.

scope: A suffix-shaped surface letter (ك/ي/ه/ا/و) that is a ROOT RADICAL — final (تملك ك of م ل ك, تهدي ي of ه د ي, تأتي ي of أ ت ي) or initial (وعد و of و ع د, not a conjunction) — is NEVER a clitic. Resolve the root and refuse the peel when the letter is a radical. The ي-family was 2-for-2 FP in C5.

defeaters: the token carries an overt clitic → a segment IS required

projector.condition: subject_realization == mustatir (no overt clitic present)
guards: distinguish agreement mention from realized morpheme
projector.projection: PREVENT the 'missing subject segment' projection — none is expected

relationships.note: Only overt morphemes get a segment; mustatir agreement does not.

scope: A mustatir / zero-marker subject (3ms perfect, 2ms/2fs imperative) requires NO suffix segment; only an OVERT clitic (ـتُ/ـتَ/ـتم/ـتن/نا/وا/ألف الاثنين/نون النسوة/ي/ك/ه…) does. The C5 detector wrongly demanded a segment for mustatir agreement mentions.

defeaters: the keyword occurs as a positive assertion (not inside a negation window) → fire

projector.condition: detector keyword occurs inside a negation window ('not a …')
projector.projection: PREVENT the false detector fire on the negated mention

relationships.note: A detector must read what the morphline asserts, not merely that a word appears.

scope: Morphline keyword matching (e.g. 'pronoun/ضمير') must parse the negation window: a NEGATED mention ('not an attached pronoun') must NOT trip the detector. ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ fired on its own disclaimer.

defeaters: the و is a واو الجماعة subject marker (not the تُمُو epenthesis) → its own segment

projector.condition: context is ـتُمُو + pronoun and the letter is و
guards: distinguish ishbāʿ waw from واو الجماعة
projector.projection: PREVENT an ishbāʿ-waw segment; keep it with the تم subject segment

relationships.note: Epenthetic fillers are not segments and must not break the byte-exact carve.

scope: In ـتُمُو + pronoun (آتيتموهن, أُورِثْتُمُوهَا) the و is حرف إشباع (epenthetic) — it stays with the تم subject segment and is never its own segment nor a root radical. A genuine واو الجماعة, by contrast, IS its own subject segment.

defeaters: the token has no jamʿ/dual pronoun cluster → rule n/a

projector.condition: an enclitic pronoun cluster (هم/هن/هما/كم) is present
projector.projection: emit ONE pronoun segment carrying the jamʿ letters + a decomposition note

relationships.note: Refines the attached-pronoun segment to keep the jamʿ letters together.

scope: The canonical split of a jamʿ/dual-marked pronoun (هُمْ، هُنَّ، هُمَا، كُمُ) is ONE pronoun segment carrying its jamʿ/ʿimād/dual letters with a sarf note decomposing them MCP-style (هاء + الميم للجمع); never a bare هـ segment that orphans the mīm/nūn.

abstention_condition: no deciding arm → HALT (review_required); never certify a root without an arm
defeaters: no POS/surface arm distinguishes the candidate roots → HALT, do not certify
more than one candidate root supports the POS reading → HALT

projector.condition: two candidate roots and exactly one supports the token's POS reading
guards: HALT if 0 or >1 roots support the POS
projector.projection: rebind to the single POS-supporting root; entry-level selection deferred to 2-vote

relationships.note: Adds a POS-reading ownership arm to the within-root HALT.

scope: Within-root HALT amendment: when a surface resolves to TWO candidate roots (قُل → ق ل ل / ق و ل), a POS reading that only ONE candidate root supports is a valid OWNERSHIP ARM. The imperative 'say' exists only for قول, so قُل rebinds to ق و ل. Absent such an arm, HALT (entry-level selection deferred to the 2-vote).

abstention_condition: root named but no forms arm → HOLD; route engine-diverse 2-vote / new-entry authoring
defeaters: an entry's usage[].forms documents the surface → the rebind IS supported

projector.condition: content token: morphology names a root but no entry usage[].forms documents the surface
projector.projection: route to review_required HOLD; block any rebind edge

relationships.note: The content-side hold: a named root without a forms arm is not ownership.

scope: A content token whose root morphology NAMES the root (رَبَّكَ → ر ب ب, ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ → ش ط ن) but whose surface is documented by NO entry's usage[].forms → HOLD (review_required). Absence of an ownership arm is INVENTORY, not proof; never fabricate a rebind edge on morphology alone.

defeaters: the whole-token verb is genuinely ROOTLESS (no root/form/person committed) → defect
an OBJECT pronoun is fused into the verb segment → the object must split (C5)

projector.condition: whole-token finite verb commits root+form+person and no object pronoun is fused
guards: object pronoun must be its own segment
projector.projection: PREVENT the C1 stem_swallow flag — the verb+subject unit is valid at the coarse tier

relationships.note: The inflectional prefix is a segment in FINE tier; the coarse tier keeps verb+subject as one valid unit.

scope: A finite verb + its subject/agreement morphology is ONE sarf unit at the coarse tier (MCP: {يُنْفِقُونَ}, {يَنْكِحْنَ}) — a committed whole-token verb with root+form+person is VALID, not a stem_swallow. The C1 theory 'an imperfect agreement prefix inside the verb segment is a defect' is REFUTED (34.1% precision). The OBJECT pronoun, by contrast, is ALWAYS its own segment; a genuinely rootless whole-token is still a defect.

abstention_condition: no governor and mood genuinely ambiguous → named-ambiguity reason, not a silent hedge
defeaters: no governor is visible and the verb is indicative by default → commit indicative
genuinely qirāʾāt-split mood → named ambiguity

projector.condition: a mood governor (لِ/أَنْ/لَمْ/لَا-nāhiya/shart) is visible before the muḍāriʿ
projector.projection: commit the governed mood; replace 'not separately asserted'

relationships.note: Mood is a stated consequence of a visible governor, per-occurrence.

scope: Mood is decidable from a visible governor (لِ/أَنْ/لَمْ/لَا الناهية/شرط) plus the final vowel: commit the mood, or state an explicit named ambiguity — never 'mood context not separately asserted' when a governor is visible.

abstention_condition: lām type genuinely ambiguous → named ambiguity; do not fold it into the verb
defeaters: a following muḍāriʿ vs a noun disambiguates أمر/تعليل from jarr
sukūn (jussive) vs fatḥa (subjunctive) on the verb confirms أمر vs تعليل

projector.condition: a prefixed lām is present; classify {amr, taleel, jarr, ibtida} then apply its consequence
projector.projection: emit the lām as its own segment with the type-specific mood/case consequence

relationships.note: Generalizes the imperative-lām rule to the full lām typology.

scope: The lām prefix has distinct types, each its OWN segment with its own consequence: لام الأمر (jussive governor), لام التعليل/كي (subjunctive via أن مضمرة), لام الجر (jarr), لام الابتداء/التوكيد (emphasis, no mood effect). The type must be resolved before glossing or segmenting.

defeaters: the verb is a muḍāriʿ → mood is applicable and should be asserted

projector.condition: aspect != imperfect and a mood (jussive/subjunctive/indicative) is asserted
guards: mabnī perfect/imperative carry no iʿrāb mood
projector.projection: hard violation; strip the mood label from the perfect/imperative

relationships.note: Only the muḍāriʿ receives jazm from a governor.

scope: HARD invariant: mood (and jazm/naṣb specifically) is a category of the muḍāriʿ ONLY. A perfect (mabnī) or an imperative is never 'majzūm/manṣūb'; asserting a mood on a non-imperfect is a violation.

abstention_condition: occurrence function genuinely ambiguous → named ambiguity for THAT occurrence only
defeaters: each occurrence is resolved on its own local function + scope (not the lexicon default)

projector.condition: a مَا/مَن reading is being applied from a different occurrence of the same surface
projector.projection: PREVENT the cross-occurrence propagation; resolve each occurrence independently

relationships.note: Makes the ما/مَن split strictly per-occurrence, even within one āyah.

scope: مَا/مَن function (نافية/موصولة/استفهامية/…) is resolved PER OCCURRENCE. The SAME surface can carry DIFFERENT functions in the SAME āyah (5:116 has relative مَا AND nāfiya مَا); never carry one occurrence's reading to another.

abstention_condition: nāhiya-vs-nāfiya genuinely ambiguous → named ambiguity; verb still keeps its root either way
defeaters: the لا is لا النافية (no jussium; indicative verb) → negation particle, no governor role

projector.condition: the particle is لا الناهية before a muḍāriʿ
projector.projection: the لا governs the verb into jussive; the verb is content keeping its root

relationships.note: Extends negation-ownership with the jussive-governor consequence of لا الناهية.

scope: لا الناهية is a jussive-forcing governor that OWNS the following verb (verb → majzūm) — distinct from لا النافية — and the verb after it is a CONTENT verb keeping its root; the negation is owned by the لا particle, not by the verb. Gloss-ownership corollary: the verb's gloss contributes only its own meaning (تَحْزَنُوا۟ = 'grieve'); the negation belongs to the لا token, so a token gloss 'do not grieve' wrongly imports لا's negation.

defeaters: the ها is not in a يا+أيها/أيتها vocative frame → it may be a genuine pronoun clitic

projector.condition: surface family is يا+أيها/أيتها and the segment under test is ها
guards: not applied to ها outside the vocative frame
projector.projection: PREVENT the pronoun-clitic projection; type ها as حرف تنبيه (vocative element)

relationships.note: A vocative-particle analog: ها التنبيه is a particle, not a pronoun.

scope: ها in the vocative compounds يا+أيها / أيتها is حرف تنبيه (attention particle) — its own vocative element, NEVER an attached pronoun clitic. Whitelist the يا+أيها/أيتها vocative compounds.

defeaters: the surface is a content token (verb-shaped root / documented noun) → not the function floor

projector.condition: surface ∈ fused-preposition+pronoun inventory (فيها/عليكم/منه/…)
projector.projection: affirm on the function-word floor; do not park in review

relationships.note: Extends the function-word floor with fused jarr+pronoun surfaces.

scope: Fused jarr+pronoun surfaces (فِيهَا, عَلَيْكُم(ُ), مِنْهُ) are closed-class function words on the affirm/function-word floor; the deterministic closed-class set must include the fused-preposition inventory so they are affirmed, not parked in review.

abstention_condition: lām genuinely ambiguous between qasam and amr → resolve by mood (marfūʿ vs majzūm), never leak an infinitive
defeaters: the lām is لام الأمر (verb majzūm, no energic nūn) → jussive command, a different type
no نون التوكيد / no oath frame → not جواب القسم

projector.condition: لام + نون التوكيد on an energic verb in an oath-answer frame
projector.projection: gloss as a finite energic future (marfūʿ); BLOCK any dictionary-infinitive/maṣdar gloss

relationships.note: A committed finite energic reading forbids the dictionary-infinitive leak.

scope: لام جواب القسم + نون التوكيد welds to a FINITE energic verb that stays مرفوع (فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ → 'they will surely cut off'), NEVER a dictionary infinitive ('to slit'). It is distinguished from لام الأمر — which forces the muḍāriʿ into jussive (majzūm) — by mood: marfūʿ + energic vs jussive. Blocking the dictionary-infinitive leak is the guard.
